rules.statement: The Kandyan law governs the matrimonial rights of a Kandyan Sinhalese woman who marries a low-country Sinhalese, and not Ordinance No. 15 of 1876.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where a Kandyan Sinhalese woman marries a low-country Sinhalese, her matrimonial rights are governed by the Kandyan law and not by Ordinance No. 15 of 1876."
